description: Fetch any Discord user by user ID: username, global name, avatar, banner, accent color and whether the account is a bot. Use it to resolve an ID taken from a message author, a mention or a poll voter; for the bot's own account use discord_get_my_user, and for guild data such as nickname, roles and join date use discord_get_guild_member (members toolset). Returns the user object. No special bot permissions. Read-only; safe to retry.

user_id.description: ID of the Discord user to fetch

name: discord_get_user

id.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string
